title: Bleeding Control Tourniquet
description: Follows the Stop the Bleed sequence for life-threatening bleeding: call for help, press hard, apply a tourniquet 2–3 inches above an arm or leg wound, and pack deep wounds. Covers improvised tourniquets, neck, chest, and belly wounds, internal bleeding, shock, and a bleeding control kit.
shortDescription: Stop the Bleed steps: pressure, tourniquet placement, and wound packing
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
